flows.title: How a shortage fixes itself
steps: Buyers want more than sellers offer (shortage)
Buyers compete, so the price rises
Quantity demanded falls, quantity supplied rises
The market moves to the equilibrium price

flows.title: How a surplus fixes itself
steps: Sellers offer more than buyers want (surplus)
Sellers compete, so the price falls
Quantity demanded rises, quantity supplied falls
The market moves to the equilibrium price

cheat.title: Formulas
items: Profit = revenue − total costs (negative = a loss).
Value captured per unit = price − cost to make it.
Market share = a firm's sales ÷ total market sales.

cheat.title: Pairs people mix up
rows: Value creation: benefit to the customer
Value capture: money the business keeps
Problem-solution fit: it solves the problem
Product-market fit: enough demand to be viable
Core competencies: what we're best at
Mass production: many, cheap per unit

cheat.title: Test-taking reminders
items: A company's own invention or hire is NOT a PESTEL factor.
Look for the BEST answer: several choices can sound true; pick the one the scenario supports.
Watch for answers that are too extreme ("always," "guarantees," "eliminates all").
Liability is the most tested idea in 1.7: unlimited (sole proprietorship, partnership) vs. limited (LLC, corporation).
